card.name: card
card.title: Card
card.description: One titled item with a short description, an optional updated date, and an optional list of tags. Use inside card-list, feature-grid, or another slot. Not as a page section on its own and not for pricing tiers.
card.overrideReason: Adds optional updated date and tag list fields for tracked items.

section.name: card-list
section.title: Card list
section.description: A collection of cards with a toggle to switch between a vertical list and a multi-column grid. Use inside tabs or sections to display a group of peer cards. Not for marketing feature highlights with a section heading (use feature-grid) or comparison tables.

navigation.name: tabs
navigation.title: Tabs
navigation.description: A heading plus labeled panels switched by tab controls. Use when a page needs two or more peer lists or views in one place. Not for site navigation, filters, or a single static section.
